en.headline: Peppa Pig’s Fun Day Out ends its Hong Kong debut today at East Kowloon Cultural Centre
en.dek: The interactive English-language musical, making its local premiere this weekend, stages its final performances on Sunday with shows at 11 am, 3 pm and 6 pm.
body: The live stage production Peppa Pig’s Fun Day Out reaches its final day in Hong Kong on Sunday 23 August at The Hall of the East Kowloon Cultural Centre in Ngau Tau Kok.

Organised by Harbourside Productions and Proactiv Entertainment, the 80-minute show (including a 20-minute interval) follows Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and friends on a day out that takes in a zoo visit and a beach party. The performance is in English with Traditional Chinese subtitles on screen and includes interactive elements such as singing and movement for young audiences.

Sunday’s scheduled times are 11 am, 3 pm and 6 pm. Tickets range from HK$190 to HK$820, with VIP seats including a post-show meet-and-greet. The venue is at 60 Ngau Tau Kok Road; the nearest MTR station is Ngau Tau Kok or Kowloon Bay. The organisers said remaining tickets are available through the official ticketing platform.

zh.headline: Peppa Pig音樂舞台劇香港首演今最後一日 東九文化中心上演
zh.dek: 互動英語音樂舞台劇《PEPPA PIG Fun Day Out!》周末於牛頭角東九文化中心首演，今日（23日）為最後一天，設上午11時、下午3時及6時三場。
body: Peppa Pig音樂舞台劇《PEPPA PIG Fun Day Out!》今日（8月23日）於牛頭角東九文化中心The Hall迎來香港首演最後一天。
由Harbourside Productions及Proactiv Entertainment主辦，全長約80分鐘（包括20分鐘中場休息），以英語演出並配有繁體中文字幕。故事講述Peppa、George、豬媽媽、豬爸爸與好友一起去動物園和沙灘參加派對，加入合唱及肢體互動，適合親子觀眾。
今日場次為上午11時、下午3時及下午6時。門票由港幣190元至820元，VIP座位包括演出後見面環節。場地地址為牛頭角道60號，鄰近港鐵牛頭角站或九龍灣站。主辦單位表示餘票可透過官方售票平台購買。
